motion.name: masked-line
motion.purpose: Hero title lines; section headings slide 110% over 1.1s on reveal.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: IntersectionObserver reveal at 12% visibility, once. Cards rise 48px without blur.

motion.name: tilt-sink
motion.value: perspective(1000px) rotateX/rotateY up to 5deg (WIP 7deg, Ficha 6deg), translateZ(-18px) (Ficha -10px), spring 0.12 per frame
motion.purpose: Cards and Ficha tilt toward the cursor and sink; fine pointer and motion allowed only.

motion.name: intro-scrub
motion.value: 260vh, sticky stage; sea tilt 0-0.62; title lift 0-0.45, fade 0.22-0.42; extras 0.16-0.34; HUD prompt 0.24-0.32; mate settle 0.10-0.70; Ficha dealt 0.28-0.70 (visible 0.32-0.46); stat rows from 0.50, 0.05 apart; cue out 0-0.06
motion.purpose: Pinned intro on screens at least 900x620 with motion allowed.

motion.name: sea
motion.value: canvas, plane 1.9x height, 72 + 30 rows, rotate 0-62deg about a 42% horizon, depth 1100, fog s^1.3, drift 0.0144 / -0.009 px per ms
motion.purpose: Hero sea; paused offscreen, on hidden tabs and under reduced motion.

motion.name: mate-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 1.01 to 0, 1.5s ease-in-out, 140ms per line; fill fade 0.9s at 1.5s; steam 4.2s loop; bob 7s
motion.purpose: Hero mate on load; Contacto mate on reveal.

motion.name: typing
motion.purpose: Hero role; frozen whole while the pinned intro is scrubbed.

motion.name: scroll-linked
motion.value: animation-timeline scroll(root) / view(), behind @supports and reduced-motion no-preference
motion.purpose: Header progress, section rule draw (entry 30% to cover 42%), cover parallax (-5% to 5% at scale 1.12), Contacto tide.

motion.name: modal
motion.value: in 0.3s translateY 16px + scale 0.97; out 0.2s translateY 8px + scale 0.98

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 0.01ms, one iteration; reveals shown; no pin; sea drawn once; no tilt, glare-follow or cursor light; no typing; no burst

breakpoints.name: pin-threshold
breakpoints.value: 900px (min-width 900px and min-height 620px pins; max-width 899px stacks the hero)

narrative.overview:
The materials are Francisco's itch.io page (franpe.itch.io): a deep night-navy ground, thin pale-blue wave lines, a line-drawn mate gourd, pale blue-grey Outfit type and a small diamond. The composition is not the itch page. It is a game booting up: a left-aligned editorial title screen over a live sea of lines, which the scroll tilts into perspective until the player card is dealt up out of the water and a HUD prompt invites the player in. The rest of the page keeps that editorial left axis: thin headings that slide up from a mask with a rule running out to a diamond, and boxed project cards that tilt and sink under the cursor like physical cards.

Density is calm and generous, on one strong left axis. Display type is thin (Outfit 200) and very large; informational and interactive type is 400–600. Structure is drawn with 1px hairlines and tonal panels. Line work in the single sky-blue accent is the decoration: the sea, the mate, rules, diamonds. Light is not a surface treatment; it exists only where the cursor is (the sea's cursor light, the Contacto light, the card glare). Screenshots and video are the proof and carry the most colour.

Dark only, by the user's decision. The user's revision-2 direction rejects reproducing the itch banner layout and the centred-hero template; the near-black + neon-lime developer palette remains an anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: Night-navy ground, tonal panels, 1px hairlines; one sky-blue accent; gold and green for status only.
Outfit throughout: 200 for display and headings, 300 for leads and sub-heads, 400–600 for UI.
One left axis: the hero title column, section headings, the dealt Ficha and the HUD prompt all start on the container's left edge.
A live canvas sea in real perspective with drift, depth fog and a cursor light; SVG wave layers elsewhere.
Diamond (◆) from one SVG token: rule terminals, nav marker, bullets, HUD prompt, timeline nodes, mate gems.
Boxed cards (Panel, hairline, 10px) that tilt and sink toward the cursor on a spring, with a screen-blended glare.
Motion is slow and eased, scrubbed by scroll where it narrates, paused offscreen, and removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Sky Rule
rules.body: Sky Link is the only hue for emphasis, line work and interaction. Gold and green appear only as status dots; the Konami confetti is an easter egg, not a precedent.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders are 1px Hairline. Hover and selection move the border toward Sky (cards to Sky at 45%); they never thicken it.

rules.name: The Thin Title Rule
rules.body: Anything read as a title (hero name, section headings, Contacto) is Outfit 200. Weight rises only as text becomes informational or interactive.

rules.name: The Masked Line Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text enter by sliding up from behind their own mask (overflow: clip), never by fading letters or blurring in.

rules.name: The Cursor Light Rule
rules.body: Light only exists under the pointer: the sea's cursor light (a soft Sky halo plus brightened strokes), the Contacto light (820px radial, screen blend), the card and Ficha glare (420px radial, screen blend). At rest nothing glows; no coloured shadows, outer glows or neon. All of it is off without a fine pointer or with reduced motion.

rules.name: The Dark Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black, soft and negative-spread, and only under lifted or floating things.

dos: Do keep the page dark only, on Night River, as the user decided.
Do compose on the container's left axis: left-aligned headings with a Sky Line rule to a diamond, the hero title column on the left, the Ficha and HUD prompt on the same edge.
Do set titles in Outfit 200 and bring them in from a mask; use 400–600 for UI.
Do draw structure with 1px Hairline borders and tonal steps (ground, alt band, panel, raised panel).
Do box interactive cards as 10px Panels with a hairline, and give them the spring tilt, sink and screen-blended glare under a fine pointer.
Do use the `--diamond` token for bullets, markers and rule terminals.
Do build wave fields from the shared wave function, in perspective on canvas for the hero sea, and stop any animated field when it is offscreen or the tab is hidden.
Do keep a scrim behind any text column that sits over the sea.
Do gate hover, tilt and cursor light behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and give every pressable a 0.94–0.97 press scale.
Do put scroll-scrubbed motion behind `@supports` or a size/motion check and keep all content visible and unpinned without it.
donts: Don't centre the hero title or reproduce the itch banner layout; the itch page supplies materials, not composition.
Don't use the near-black + neon-lime developer palette.
Don't add static glows, coloured shadows or neon; light appears only under the cursor, and blur only in the scrolled header.
Don't use Ember Gold or Online Green as decoration; they mark status only.
Don't place uppercase labels above section headings; labels name fields inside components.
